why_blocked: The PK type is wrong on all fifteen and they reference each other, so they must move together
Fixing two of fifteen leaves the only correct models on a base (NursingBaseEntity) that is itself wrong
The correct shape is the M1-M4 pattern proven for Pharmacy — its own authorised batch
